<br>

#### **Single-cell ATAC-seq, Session 1: Foundations**

This session introduces the concepts and data structures behind scATAC-seq.

* A refresher on chromatin accessibility and ATAC-seq
* The benefits and costs of single-cell resolution
* Cell Ranger ATAC (and other preprocessor) outputs: fragment files and the peak-by-cell count matrix
* Importing data with Signac/Seurat: the ChromatinAssay, fragments, annotations and motifs
